Set off on an exciting Macuco Safari jeep ride through the jungle. A guide accompanies you, sharing information about the national park. After traveling through the jungle and continuing on foot, you reach a dedicated platform on the Iguaçu River, where an exhilarating boat trip toward the waterfalls awaits.

Aboard a specially equipped motorboat, you approach the falls at very close range. Enjoy extraordinary views of the waterfalls as well as the mountain slopes covered in tropical greenery.

Your heart will race and the adrenaline will surge as you find yourself beneath a solid curtain of water plunging from above, with remarkable views of the falls.

You can order a DVD to relive the experience again and again!

Group tour. Wear comfortable shoes and clothing.

Before arriving in the modern city, visit León Viejo, the archaeological remains of the original León, founded by the Spanish in 1524 and abandoned after natural disasters in 1610.

In León, the itinerary includes the cathedral, the Rubén Darío Museum, the Ortiz-Gurdián Museum and murals depicting the Nicaraguan Revolution. The day connects the ancient settlement with the modern city and its literature, art and history.

Mashpi Lodge is located in a reserve covering about 1,300 hectares of Ecuadorian rainforest. The two days here revolve around nature: walks through the forest, birdwatching, evening outings after dinner and early-morning activities when the forest is especially lively.

The drive from Quito is also part of the experience. Along the way, pass the Middle of the World monument and the equator line, stop at the Pululahua viewpoint, then visit the Tulipe Archaeological Museum, where pools and other structures of the Yumbo culture have been preserved.

Guests arrive at Mashpi at approximately 12:00–12:30. After a welcome drink, check-in, an introductory briefing and lunch, the first activity begins. It is chosen according to group size, guests' physical condition and the weather. After dinner, an evening walk is available for those who wish to join.

You can begin the following morning before breakfast, when the birds are particularly active. The program then continues with a nature excursion. Lunch is scheduled before departure at around 13:30, followed by the return journey across the Andes to Quito.
